name: The Black Mamba
notes: Known from one DAVE sample served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/sample-rp-2002-01-23.html: the EWA star and former OSW champion, the "Epitome of Intensity", who hosts a "hostile takeover" of Through the Keyhole and expects to become the EWA British champion.
